purpose: Forensic, provenance-preserving decomposition of current Frankenstein source into architecture/coupling evidence that can feed the existing architecture-archaeology pipeline and a future GRID10/Frankenstein-2.0 integration view without creating a second product, state authority, effect authority or persistent entity.

trigger_definition.intent: Decompose Frankenstein source forensically at code-line granularity, preserve architecture and provenance, provide an append-only worker result format, and make findings directly reusable by GRID10/Frankenstein-2.0 design work.
trigger_definition.execution_rule: Source archaeology and durable research delta only in this run; do not modify the Frankenstein harness or claim runtime/causal acceptance from source inspection.

authority_snapshot.evidence_boundary: source wiring != runtime causal effect; historical/current component evidence != EntityOS/HCU runtime acceptance

source_snapshot.commit_message: research: localize post-gate fallback caller source

forensic_findings.claim: All seven declared Claude lifecycle hooks converge on the same stern.py hook dispatcher command instead of separate hook-owned state authorities.
forensic_findings.failure_avoided: divergent lifecycle handlers and multiple independent state writers

forensic_findings.claim: stern.py declares a hard boundary that model output never directly writes unified.db; event-triggered stern.py code performs writes with evidence.

wegehierarchie.py remains a required external dependency because paket.py performs a runtime import for F94; an earlier cleanup that removed it silently disabled downstream behavior until self-test exposed the missing module.
forensic_findings.triggerwort5_rule_derived: A file/module may be retired only after import/call/replay reachability has been demonstrated, not from static naming or apparent duplication alone.

forensic_findings.claim: Current architecture separates PreToolUse admission from PostToolUse outcome verification before a verified effect is recorded.
visual_cortex.py imports voice_loop_core and explicitly reuses Kandidat/score_kandidat/arbitrieren rather than defining a second visual arbitration formula.
voice_loop_core implements WAIT as an explicit candidate/baseline; deterministic user_present and self_resolvable gates are evaluated before weighted initiative scoring.
forensic_findings.architecture_role: bounded initiative and reflection/action exit semantics

forensic_findings.claim: perceptual_field.py uses separate ObservedEvidence, InferredHypothesis and RetrievalPrior types; RetrievalPrior.can_override_observation is non-caller-settable false and resolve_person_presence can only add a small agreement confidence nudge, not replace the observed value.
visual_cortex.py now reuses capture_worker shared ownership to avoid competing camera handles; source comments record the prior Device-or-resource-busy failure caused by independent consumers.
perceptual_field.py places an explicit salience gate before reuse of the shared GWT candidate/arbitration machinery so high-frequency perception does not automatically become workspace ignition.

Current v0.7 visual cortex still contains an external semantic vision-engine route while the stricter target recorded by current research is local Retina/temporal/UnifiedDB/GWT core perception with UNKNOWN instead of automatic cloud semantic escalation.

coupling_edge_deltas.functional_rule: each declared hook executes python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/stern.py hook
coupling_edge_deltas.delay: bounded by declared hook command timeouts 2-8 seconds depending on event; internal stern budgets are separately constrained
coupling_edge_deltas.persistence: dispatcher process is nonpersistent; durable state is externalized to unified.db/log surfaces
historical_failures_affecting_edge: multi-handler/state-fragmentation risk; hidden external dependency risk
coupling_edge_deltas.harness_intervention_handle: disable or substitute one hook route while holding event payload constant; verify downstream state/effect difference and fail-silent behavior

coupling_edge_deltas.functional_rule: visual_cortex imports and reuses voice_loop_core Kandidat/score_kandidat/arbitrieren without an independent weight set
coupling_edge_deltas.timescale: per invoked visual cycle / per candidate arbitration
coupling_edge_deltas.persistence: weights/configuration persist outside candidate objects; individual candidates are request/cycle scoped
coupling_edge_deltas.harness_intervention_handle: run matched visual and voice candidate sets through shared scorer; lesion shared scorer or shuffle candidate features and compare winner/WAIT behavior

coupling_edge_deltas.functional_rule: prior disagreement sets overridden_prior audit flag and cannot change observed_value; agreement may add fixed +0.05 confidence capped at 1.0
coupling_edge_deltas.persistence: prior source is durable memory; resolved hypothesis/event may be persisted by caller
coupling_edge_deltas.harness_intervention_handle: adversarial prior-vs-observation contradiction plus reversed contradiction and agreement control

coupling_edge_deltas.functional_rule: consumers obtain frames from one shared/refcounted capture worker instead of opening competing device handles
coupling_edge_deltas.timescale: high-frequency frame stream plus occasional visual cycles
historical_failures_affecting_edge: Device or resource busy from competing capture handles
coupling_edge_deltas.harness_intervention_handle: compare shared-owner path against deliberately isolated duplicate-open test in an authorized local fixture, not on production hardware unless explicitly admitted

grid10_candidate_mapping.rule: GRID10 cells are logical request-scoped function slots, not permanent mini-agents or claims of physical model concurrency.
grid10_candidate_mapping.open_falsifier: This partition is only useful if lesion/shuffle/replay experiments show that the preserved functions and causal boundaries survive the migration and no cell boundary creates a new state/effect authority.

preserve: shared arbitration rather than modality-specific policy forks
effect admission distinct from verified outcome
dynamic reachability proof before deleting compatibility code
do_not_copy_blindly: stern.py monolith topology as a mandatory future module boundary
external semantic vision API as core presence/perception dependency
source comments or docs as runtime proof
fixed GRID10 cell identities as permanent agents
frankenstein_2_0_integration_contract.authority_boundary: Frankenstein-2.0 remains a research/implementation target subordinate to canonical EntityOS + HCU authority in this pipeline.

merge_law: same dedupe key is one observation family, not independent replication
conflicting packets are preserved side-by-side until source chronology/evidence resolves them
worker consensus never upgrades evidence class
a source-ready rule is not executed evidence
line-level findings must preserve exact source commit and blob identity
later source commits create new observations; they do not overwrite old provenance
